batting.name: S Dhawan
batting.dismissal: c DB Das b R Bhatia

batting.name: CL White
batting.dismissal: c DB Das b B Lee

batting.name: IR Jaggi
batting.dismissal: c BB McCullum b SP Narine

batting.name: Ankit Sharma
batting.dismissal: c G Gambhir b L Balaji

batting.name: DW Steyn
batting.dismissal: c MK Tiwary b SP Narine

batting.name: G Gambhir
batting.dismissal: c KC Sangakkara b Anand Rajan

batting.name: JH Kallis
batting.dismissal: c PA Patel b DW Steyn

balls.text: cannot get the full delivery away as he clears the front leg
hit to deep midwicket
was prepared for the reverse paddle even before the ball was delivered, managed to get it towards cover, and would have been gone had the throw hit
full ball it to deep midwicket
Narine bowls it wider of the batsman this time, Steyn has to reach out as he advances out again, long on dives forward to take the mishit
Steyn gets six off the first ball, he took a few steps out, got to the pitch, and lofted it with a straight bat out of long on's reach
slower one from back of a length down leg, but he seemed to have got a touch on it, and it's not called wide
works a full ball down to long on
runs a slowish length ball to point

that is a very fine take from Gambhir in the end, Ankit edges a slog high in the air over cover off a slower one, Gambhir was under it, but misjudged it as it came down away from him, he reached out and somehow managed to hold on as he tumbled to the ground
swings a length ball away off the pad but straight to short fine leg
drives an angled delivery to mid off and they go through for the run, he was gone easily had the throw hit at the bowler's end
flighted across him, driven wide of long off
pushed down the track
another one goes, he left the crease more in hope than anything else, it was the carrom ball, and he could only mishit it for long off to come in and settle underneath it
takes it on the full but hits it to deep midwicket
we have a boundary from Deccan, Duminy charges out, is not close to the pitch, goes through with the slog and dispatches the offbreak between long on and deep midwicket
pulls a flicked delivery turning away from him, down to long on
and another dot ball, top over from Lee, this time he angles it widish across Duminy, who throws his bat at it only to get beaten again
tries to pull from outside off but cannot connect, what an over from Lee
he was backing away again, this time Lee bowls it slower at 121 kph, he reaches out to push in the air past cover
clueless at the moment against Lee, backs away too much outside leg, tries to connect with a swipe but is beaten once again
that was quick, that was 141 kph, took off from a length outside off, he withdrew his bat, after getting beaten
allows a length ball to come on and runs it to point
gets bat around pad to work to deep square
turned in the region of midwicket, Bhatia goes after it and fields
and now he's gone, another build-up wasted by Dhawan, he gets a full toss, goes after it, and finds deep midwicket
pushed down to long on past the bowler
worked behind square leg to bring up a fifty, a rather painful one as he approached the landmark
pushed to covers, almost at a run a ball now
pulled to deep midwicket

he was gone by a mile had the throw hit, Dhawan's innings has tapered off completely, pushed towards cover and took off right away, there was no run, Dhawan had given up trying to regain his ground, but the throw was poor
cannot get this one away, tries to go hard at a length ball, it rolls off pad down the pitch
opens the face and runs a length ball from middle behind point
dropped in front of point for a quick single
White is gone, goes for the pull to a sharp short delivery, is hurried into the stroke, and deep square leg runs to his left to take a well-judged catch
defends a slower one that moves across him from leg
backs away a shade outside leg, but only manages to hit a full toss down to long on
reaches out to a full delivery but cannot work it past the bowler
hit wide of long off for a couple
punched from the crease, it runs away in the gap past short third man, and is too quick for Yusuf's dive
low full toss on the stumps, hit down to long on
this one turned away from a length, White had set himself up early to paddle it from outside off, but missed it by quite some distance
full delivery worked off the pad through square leg
works a flighted ball from middle down to long on
punches a offbreak from the crease to sweeper cover
comes down the track this time, he slows it up as he flights it, and he has to block it again
pushes a tossed up offbreak back to Narine
leans forward and across to the pitch of the full ball and pushes to extra cover
worked behind square leg
driven down to long off

Parthiv is walking off in disgust, shaking his head, Dhawan had turned down a few second runs earlier, this time he was right in turning the second down, but Parthiv was already halfway up the pitch after driving to sweeper cover, the throw was on target to Bhatia, who took the bails off before the ball slipped out of his hands
slowish and full on leg, turned towards vacant midwicket, Bhatia goes after it
swings at a low full toss and finds Lee on the deep midwicket boundary, but it is the free-hit, and they take a single
whipped away in front of square leg
length delivery on middle, he runs it towards backward point, takes a few steps out, but has to return in time as the fielder gets to the ball
tumbling stop at square third man saves the four
hit down to sweeper cover
opens the face and runs it behind point
flicked in the air over short fine leg
back of a length ball dropped onto the off side for one
full delivery driven down to long off
flicks a full one off the pads to deep square
close to the blockhole, turned towards Lee at deep midwicket, again they make do with the single
turns the slower one away around off, he stays in the crease and dabs it to short third
works a slowish length ball towards deep midwicket, fielder took some time in getting to the ball, they settle for one in the end
moving away after pitching on a length, thick edge down to short third man
pulled away to deep midwicket
cut hard, McCullum cannot stop it at shortish point with a dive, Tiwary does it with another dive from backward point
misses the flick off the pads, they take a run as the ball rolls towards on the off side
tries to dab a climbing delivery behind point, but it was too close to him, and he is beaten
takes a couple of steps outside the crease and thumps the length ball over extra cover
full one worked off the pads to fine leg
slower one moves across the left-hander from short of a length, pushed towards point
hit to sweeper cover for a single
leading edge as he pushes forward, McCullum is at a shortish point, and his leap is not enough to get to the ball
pushed away towards point
times the tuck off the pads in the gap between the two men in the deep square on leg
forced away to sweeper cover
pulled through square leg
beats the outside edge with a slower one which moves away from the left-hander
driven to sweeper cover

Dhawan survives, barely, he had advanced too far down the pitch before being sent  back after dropping one in front of Tiwary at point, Tiwary charged in, dived in front and found the stumps with the under-arm lob, but Dhawan's dive had him just making his ground
too much width given for the cut outside off, and Dhawan times the stroke well, he also places it well wide of sweeper cover
worked behind square leg for a couple
whipped wristily off the pads behind square leg, man in the deep runs to his left and cuts it off close to the rope
Sanga has charged for the last time tonight, makes room outside leg as he leaves the crease to have another swipe, misses the fullish delivery which takes out middle
he saw him coming down the pitch, and took the pace off this short of a length ball which bounced over his swing in the end
allows this one to come on and drops it towards cover
punched towards backward point
Lee has saved the boundary with a run to his left and a big dive at mid off, it was struck hard by Sanga
well done, skips down the track, not quite to the pitch of the offbreak but reaches out to lift it over mid on
defended down the track
down the track, but misses the line and is hit on the pads
tosses up the offbreak on leg stump, he gets forward and defends
offbreak turning away from the left-hander, pushed to point
Lee on target around off with a length ball, Dhawan cannot push it away on to the off side, it rolls on to the pitch
tried to turn this one off the pads, but could not connect as he was beaten by the pace, the ball rolls towards point
cracking stroke from Dhawan, gets forward and slams a length delivery through the packed off-side infield, it races through extra cover
right on middle from back of a length, cannot do anything with that, pushes it on the off side close to the pitch
neatly done, it was short and climbing into him, he was hurried but adjusted to control the pull past short fine leg
worked off the pad in front of square leg
now Sanga leaves the crease, and lofts this one cleanly between bowler and mid on
stays in the crease and softly drops it on the off side
comes down the track, gets to the pitch, and lifts it from off over wide long on
driven to mid off
this one came in to the left-hander who got an inside edge to short fine leg
shuffles across and tucks a length ball off middle in front of square leg
Lee puts in more effort on this back of a length ball and finds some bounce on it, steered down to third man
whoa, that hardly got up, it looked like the slower one, it came off slowly at least, but it was clocked at 137 kph, pushed on the off side
this one went through alright, at decentish bounce, Dhawan beaten as he went for the cut
gets some width outside off on a length, but dabs it to backward point who runs to his left and dives to stop the ball, Tiwary it is
has a go from the crease at a length ball going across him, misses as the ball keeps low, it was clocked at over 142 kph, came slowly off the wicket though, Lee stares at the pitch
comes down the track, YK fires it in to the pads on a length, nudged in front of square
flighted but full on the pads, worked through midwicket
goes back and punches a flat delivery, again down to long off
pushes a length ball past a diving extra cover to long off
drives a full and tossed up ball to long off
shuffles across to a length ball spinning away a tad outside off, tucks it square on leg for one
atrocious wide a mile down the leg side from Duminy, and that will do for KKR
cuts a turning delivery to short third man
hit on the bounce to long on
lovely delivery, the tossed up googly, he goes for the drive thinking it was a legbreak, it turns in and goes between bat and off stump
full one whipped hard down to long on
down the track and chips it over the bowler for a boundary, safe shot
worked through midwicket
wide outside off and turning further away
Das cashes in, he goes over mid off now, flat-bats another back of a length ball high over the fielder
dropped, Chargers have dropped another catch, mistimes the slog off a shortish one, sailed towards long on who ran in, dived, got his hands to the ball, and it popped out
gets out of the way of a sharp bouncer that was aimed right at his head
pushed to sweeper cover
similar delivery, similar result, another single, this one was closer, midwicket got to the ball and threw towards the non-striker's stumps, but Das was in the way
drops a back of a length ball on the leg side and they go through for a quick run
hangs his bat a bouncing short one outside off and gets it to third man

whoa, he backs away outside leg and throws his bat at a length ball which goes to mid off, Steyn has a go at Tiwary, who then walks out of his crease towards Steyn, Sanga at mid off, the crafty Sanga, ever alive to a slight opening, throws the ball at the striker's stumps, and nearly hits them, what if he had?
thick outside edge as the ball bounces, and flies to third man
has him pegged in the crease with a pacy length ball, pushed out towards point, he wants the single, but is sent back rightly

Steyn wins the battle with his South Africa team-mate, he roars, Kallis pushes hard and straight at the pitched up delivery, it moves away slightly, another outside edge, not as thick as the previous one, and settles into the keeper's gloves
first ball Kallis makes room outside leg, and takes a step out, outside edge flies past the keeper as Kallis has a go
calmly punched to sweeper cover
again looked like he would charge out, remained in the crease, and punched to sweeper cover
KKR making a needless mess of this now, tries to sweep from outside off, misses, drags the back foot, Parthiv has the bails off, but Tiwary has managed to get some part of the boot back, just in time
uncertain, he looked to leave the crease initially, then decided to stay on the front foot, and ended up almost lobbing a flighted ball back to the bowler, he dived forward but it fell just short
hits a length ball to sweeper cover
punched down to long on
swivels as he pulls a short ball dug into him, it is in the air for a while but is also wide of deep square, who runs to his left and scrambles on his knees to haul it back
reaches out a long way and pushes to sweeper cover
bangs it in short, he stands in his crease and drops it towards point
rides the bounce to guide one to sweeper cover
worked off the pad wide of deep square leg
googly, but shortish, he goes back and pulls to deep midwicket
reaches out and pushes to extra cover
driven down to long off
tossed up full delivery driven with an open face through point
hits a full one hard through extra cover, long off fields
well done, down the track early, Mishra dragged it wide, but he reached to the pitch and lifted it over extra cover
works a tossed up ball through square leg
reaches out and pushes to point
length ball hit to sweeper cover
makes some room and drives hard, but cannot beat point
drives a flighted one to extra cover
drives a tossed up ball wide of long off who fumbles the pick-up but they settle for one
opens the face and runs another wide one to third man
well done, just hangs his bat out and times the wide one past point, Mishra puts in an awkward dive from third man to save the four
loud appeal for lbw, that was clearly missing leg though
drives crisply off the front foot but bowler gets down in time to stop the ball
worked on the leg side, midwicket dives, but parries the ball away for them to take one
that missed the edge, and the stumps, by about an inch, length ball angled in, Tiwary pushes inside the line, the ball bounces just over the top of middle
that straightened sharply and bounced, it was angled in on the pads, Kallis looked to work it away but had to adjust to awkwardly defend as it turned
more flight from Ankit, but on leg stump, worked in front of square

he's gone, surely KKR are not going to mess up another middling chase? similar length to the one he clobbered for six, but the line is on the stumps, Yusuf decides even this one has to disappear in the same area, has a slog at it, misses, and the ball crashes into middle
he's taken off early, the ball was outside off, Yusuf fetched it with his big reach and mowed it over wide long on
gets forward and defends a skiddy length ball
nudged off the pad to fine leg
tentatively defends a length ball down the pitch
the short ball right away to Yusuf, too short though
and once again, Gambhir has thrown away an in-control innings, nothing delivery, pitched up outside off, he comes forward and drives it in the air straight to mid off
allows a length ball to come on and tackles the slight bounce well to run it to third man
Gambhir is suddenly looking in a hurry, makes room outside leg and runs a length ball behind point
forcefully whips a full one through midwicket
shortish delivery sitting up, pulled away through midwicket, long on runs to his left, dives and saves the boundary
pushes a tossed up legbreak to the bowler
down the track, takes it on the full but times it to deep midwicket
tossed up wide goodly, he takes the bait and goes after it, thick inside edge runs past the keeper
defended on the off side
oh dear, that has gone through sweeper cover, should have been only one, was driven hard but straight to the fielder, and straight through him
short and sitting up, punched wide of sweeper cover
full ball worked to deep midwicket
short outside off, punched to sweeper cover
worked off the pad to fine leg
tossed up and straight down the leg side
would have been a big wide down leg had he not nudged it to fine leg
shuffles too far across and just gets the bat down in time to work it to short fine
full and down leg
bowled 'em! that has skidded and straightened from a good length and crashed into middle, Bisla caught on the crease, had a waft at it but was beaten as it rushed on
worked with the spin to deep square
thick inside edge towards long on as he pushes forward
pushes a length ball back to the bowler
comes out initially, Mishra bowls it flatter, and he pushes with the turn to point
pushes  a tossed up legbreak on the off side
has him ducking under a short ball
pushed towards mid off
lovely stroke, Bisla tried this against Steyn the previous over, did not succeed, this time he does not back away as much, just enough to be able to ping the full delivery past cover, superb timing
pushed towards point for one
goes for it again, but short extra cover does well to stop the ball with a dive
crashed through cover, he comes down the track, and uses the width to slam the ball past cover
arches back a bit and lets this short ball go past him
on the pads with the angle, and the nudge is enough to take it fine past the keeper
rolls his wrists over the short of a length ball and works it to fine leg
rolls backward of square off the pad
nothing shot in the end, he was making room outside leg to go through extra cover, but could not find any timing on the pacy length ball in the end
adjusts for the away swing and pushes the pitched up ball to point
pushes a pitched up ball to mid off
straight and down the leg side as he misses the nudge
stays in the crease and dabs a short of a length ball to backward point
goes for the pull, thick edge goes screaming high over keeper and wide slip
too wide outside off, he reaches out and mishits it to cover off the toe end of the bat
wrong line to Gautam, on the pad, and he instantly flicks it over square leg
beats him outside off as Gambhir tries to dab a length ball to third man
too good, Bisla nods in acknowledgement towards Steyn, good pace, and moves away sharply after drawing the batsman into a prod, for good measure, it bounces a lot too
hurls it full and wide down leg

he is gone this time, that stayed low, it pitched short of a length, McCullum was in the mood to pull, but ended up swinging above the ultimate path of the ball, which crashed into the back leg, right in front, did not seem to be a slower one, done in by the pitch then
typical McCullum, bashes a length delivery violently down to deep midwicket
defended towards extra cover
candidate for shot of the day, Steyn swings it away fullish, McCullum leans forward, adjusting for the movement and eases it as softly as a McCullum can between mid off and extra cover
slashes hard and hits it on the bounce to third man
worked to deep midwicket
full ball worked to midwicket
moves forward to push this one down to long off
pushes a length ball to the bowler
defended on the off side
pushes a tossed up delivery on leg stump to Sanga at mid on, he fails to pick up the ball, and concedes the second as well, already then ...
has him getting on his toes to defend a rising back of a length ball
gets hold of this one, going across him, he strides forward and times the drive through extra cover
swings back in once again, this time he forces it back to the bowler

excellent delivery again, shapes in and bounces to strike him on the flap of the pads he hops, then carries to the keeper, Gautam raised his bat as the appeal is turned down, did not seem to be any bat there, and it looked a shade high for the lbw
beats him first up, Gambhir saw the line going across him and went for the drive, but the ball swung in appreciably to beat the inside edge
swinging away full around off, pushed towards mid off for one
